no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee, because Vilazodone is one of now many antidepressants with predominantly SSRI activity, and efficacy and safety profiles seemed similar to others in the class. Absent other critical review issues, the Division decided, and the Office concurred, that not taking the application to an advisory committee was reasonable and justified.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for VIIBRYD (vilazodone, NDA022567). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director Memo, and Medical Review) all state the Division did not take the application to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee because vilazodone was another antidepressant with a predominantly SSRI profile whose efficacy and safety were similar to others in the class, and there were no controversial or critical review issues warranting a meeting. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
